title: Metriko stage regression harness: per-stage diff against TSV ground truth
description:
Pipeline currently feature-complete (PATCH-50/54/41/42/43/58) but only validated on toy meshes. End-to-end Hand-30k produces 0 motorcycle traces / 0 patches / 0 quads because of upstream IGM convergence limits — we can't tell which downstream stages are right.

We have metriko's intermediate outputs as TSV fixtures (PATCH-51 carryover). Use them as input AND ground truth for stage-by-stage validation:

- stage2_uv_corners.tsv  → per-corner UVs (input to motorcycle / QEx)
- stage3_tedges.tsv      → T-mesh arcs (ground truth for our motorcycle output)
- stage3_tedge_R.tsv     → per-arc rotation indices  
- stage4_tedge_X.tsv     → integer arc-length vector (ground truth for our quantization)
- hand-quad.obj          → metriko's final quad mesh (ground truth for our QEx)

Stages to validate:
1. Motorcycle + T-mesh: load stage2 UVs, run our MotorcycleGraph.trace + TMesh.build, compare arc count + topology to stage3.
2. Quantization: load stage3 T-mesh + parametric lengths, run our Quantization.solve, compare arc-length vector to stage4.
3. QEx: load stage2 UVs, run our QuadMeshExtractor.extract, compare quad/vertex counts to hand-quad.obj.

Per-stage diff isolates exactly where our impl diverges from the reference. Output: pass/fail per stage + numeric diff metrics. Future regression suite.

This is the foundational unblocker for PATCH-44 (Lyon enhancements), PATCH-56 (scene viz), PATCH-57 (DSL emit) — all of which assume our motorcycle/quantization/QEx are correct on real input.
definition-of-done: PrecomputedFieldImporter extended with loadStage2Param, loadStage3TMesh, loadStage4Quantization. New MetrikoStageRegressionTest class with at least 3 tests (motorcycle, quantization, QEx). Each test prints a numeric diff against the metriko ground truth and asserts a tolerance. CLI VerifyMetrikoStageDiff prints the same diff metrics for manual inspection.
testing-plan: 1. Stage 2 → motorcycle: assert |our_arc_count - metriko_arc_count| < 10% of metriko_arc_count. 2. Stage 3 → quantization: assert per-arc q vector matches metriko's stage4 vector exactly (same ILP problem should produce same optimum). 3. Stage 2 → QEx: assert |our_quad_count - metriko_quad_count| < 5% of metriko_quad_count. Tolerances loosen if needed once we see the actual diffs.
